units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 24:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIV</cite> <he>יש רש ואין שמו לפי רָשׁוּתוֹ</he> (ed. Bub. <he>עניותו</he>) many a man is poor, but his reputation is not in harmony with his poverty (it being that he is wealthy).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 147:4">Yalk. Gen. 147</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 4:14">Koh. IV, 14</cite>) <he>במלכותו … נולדה רָשׁוּתוֹ וכ׳</he> with Joseph’s elevation to governorship Potiphar’s poverty was born; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 89:3">Gen. R. s. 89</cite> <he>רִשְׁתּוֹ</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 971:13">Yalk. Koh. 971</cite> <he>רשתו</he>.
